try: The listing on a phone says who to call now
how:
1. On your phone (the Network address from chapter 12), tap "Leads"
2. Look at Chloe Tan's card, then Farah Ahmad's
3. Tap "n to call today" at the top
expect: Each card carries a "Last" line (how and when the client was last reached) and a "Next" line (the next follow-up). Chloe Tan, whom nobody has opened yet, has a coloured band and a "New" tag. Farah Ahmad's Next line is red and says how many days late. A WhatsApp button sits beside each number, and the stage pill is at the left of the card's foot, clear of the Maison AI button. "n to call today" narrows the list to leads with a follow-up due today or late, and the pill names it; going into a lead and back keeps it.
in10: Different from 1.0: the card says when you last spoke and what comes next

try: Move a lead nobody owns from its card
how:
1. On the listing, tap Olivia Martinez's stage pill
2. Read the first row, then tap "Assign"
3. Tick a member and tap "Assign"
expect: The sheet names Olivia. Its first row is the next move, "Move to Contacted", and it says a member must be assigned first, with "Assign" beside it. After you assign someone, the Move stage window opens at Contacted, so the move carries on where you were. Close it without saving.

try: Add a lead by pasting the client's WhatsApp message
how:
1. On the listing, tap + › "Create New Lead"
2. Copy this text and tap "Paste the WhatsApp message": Hi, I'm Rachel Ong, we just got our keys at Blk 123 Bedok North Ave 1 #08-12, my number is 9334 1209
3. Tap ✕, then "Keep editing"; then tap "Add lead"
expect: The form starts with just Name and Mobile; everything else sits under "More details". Pasting fills the name, the mobile (shown as "9334 1209") and the address. ✕ asks before throwing away what you typed. "Add lead" opens Rachel's new lead.
in10: Different from 1.0: a new lead is a name and a mobile, and a pasted chat fills the rest

try: A lead on a phone is one page with its tabs
how:
1. On the listing, tap Farah Ahmad
2. Scroll the tab strip under the header and tap "Tasks", then "Overview"
expect: Farah opens on her page as before: the header with her name, "Stage: Contacted" and "Move to Met", the tab strip under it, then the Overview's cards. Tapping a tab changes the page below the strip in place; there is no extra screen to go back from. Nothing scrolls sideways.

try: Log a call in the log sheet
how:
1. Open Kelvin Goh (New) › "Notes & Logs"
2. Tap "New" › "Contact Log"
3. Tap "Callback requested", tap "Tomorrow 10:00", tap "Save log"
expect: The log opens as a sheet with Call already chosen and the time set to now; the outcomes are chips and "Callback requested" shows the call-back presets. Saving logs the call and moves Kelvin to Contacted in the same step; the snackbar says so and names the call-back in Tasks. The header's button now reads "Move to Met".
in10: Different from 1.0: logging a call is one sheet, and on a new lead it also moves the lead to Contacted

try: Log a call on a lead nobody owns
how:
1. Open Olivia Martinez › "Notes & Logs"
2. Tap "New" › "Contact Log"
3. Pick the suggested member, choose "Connected" and save
expect: Before anything else the sheet asks "Who owns Olivia?" with a suggested member. Picking one assigns them and the call is logged and moves Olivia to Contacted. If you pick nobody, the call is logged and Olivia stays in New.

try: Log a site visit with a photo and move to Met
how:
1. Open Farah Ahmad (Contacted) › "Notes & Logs" › "New" › "Contact Log"
2. Tap the "Site visit" chip
3. Tap "Take a photo" (or "Choose a file"), then "Save & move to Met"
expect: With Site visit chosen the button reads "Save & move to Met"; a photo is optional. Saving logs the visit and moves Farah to Met.

scene: Moving a stage on your phone
try: The Move stage window is one step at a time
how:
1. Open Jasmine (Contacted) and tap "Move to Met" in the header
2. Tap "Save & move" with nothing filled in
3. Fill the fields (pick Showroom) and tap "Save & move"
expect: The window is one screen: a bar "Move to Met" over "Jasmine … · step 3 of 5", only this step's fields, and one "Save & move" at the bottom. Saving with nothing filled keeps the window open and says what is missing at the foot; nothing typed is lost. Filled in, the lead moves to Met.

scene: Moving a stage on your phone
try: Win a lead with a photo of the signed quote
how:
1. Open Vivien and tap "Convert to Project" in the header
2. Under Signed quote open the "Upload" tab and tap "Take a photo", type the amount
3. Check the payment split, choose a project type and tap "Create project"
expect: Won is a checklist: Signed quote, Signed contract, Payments and Project type. The photo is kept as the signed quote. The payments show the studio's usual 10 · 30 · 30 · 30, not 0%. "Create project" makes the project and opens it.
in10: Different from 1.0: on a phone, Won is a short checklist and a photo of the paper counts as the signed quote

scene: Moving a stage on your phone
try: Put a lead on hold and undo it
how:
1. Open Priya, tap "Stage: Contacted" › "On Hold"
2. Pick a reason and "3 months", tap "Save & move"
3. Tap "Undo" in the snackbar
expect: On Hold is one sheet: the studio's reasons as chips, the duration chips, one button. After saving, the snackbar offers Undo, and Undo puts Priya back where she was. Only one snackbar shows at a time.

scene: The lead's tabs on your phone
how:
1. Open Olivia Martinez › the "Tasks" tab
2. Tick a task's ring, then tap "Undo"
3. Hold a task, then tap a second one
4. Type a new task in the bar at the bottom, tap "Tomorrow 10:00" and add it
expect: Each task is a card with a round tick, its whole name and a due chip (late ones in red). Holding a card selects it, with no checkboxes, and the bar offers "Mark done", "Assign" and "More…". The quick add at the bottom takes a title, a due preset and who it is for. The same cards are on Tasks in the rail and a project's Tasks.

scene: The lead's tabs on your phone
try: Files: take a photo straight into a folder
how:
1. Open Olivia Martinez › the "Files" tab, open the Kitchen folder
2. Tap "Take a photo", take one
3. Open a picture, pinch to zoom, double-tap, swipe to the next
expect: The toolbar is one row: "Take a photo", search and ⋮. The camera opens at once; the photo lands in the open folder and the snackbar offers "Take another". The viewer pinches, pans, double-taps and swipes to the next file; Information opens as a short sheet.

try: A lead on a tablet is the same page
how:
1. On a tablet, open Farah Ahmad, held upright and then sideways
2. Scroll to the end of the Overview
expect: The page is the lead's page with its header, tab strip and cards at both orientations; tabs change in place. On a touch tablet the Maison AI button stays out of the way while there is page below and shows at the end.

how:
1. On a tablet, open "Leads" in the table view
2. Open Column settings, hide a column and close it
3. Switch to the kanban and open a card's ⋮
expect: The table opens on Name · Stage · Last contact · Next follow-up · Members, with Edit and ⋮ held at the right edge. Column settings' handles are finger-sized, and what you change is kept for the tablet only. A kanban card carries its stage pill, and its ⋮ offers "Move to {next stage}" and "Move stage…".

try: A Designer logs a call on a lead nobody owns
how:
1. Switch to Germaine (Designer) with View as
2. Open a New lead nobody owns › "Notes & Logs" › "New" › "Contact Log"
expect: Germaine sees the log sheet without the owner row; its line says the lead stays in New until someone owns it, and saving logs the call without moving the lead.
